Lindiwe (an illustration) takes home R14,000 in December. Step one: list everything due before the next pay on 29 January: rent R4,000, debit orders R900, taxi fare for six weeks R2,400, groceries for six weeks R4,500 and back to school R1,200. That's R13,000. Step two: pay January first: on payday, move the R13,000 into a separate savings pocket, away from your card. Step three: your festive budget is what's left: R1,000 from her pay, plus her R6,000 stokvel payout: R7,000.

About the example: R4,000 + R900 + R2,400 + R4,500 + R1,200 = R13,000; R14,000 - R13,000 = R1,000; R1,000 + R6,000 = R7,000.

Full guide: "Festive Season on a Budget: How Not to Start January Broke (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
